blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Agriculture (DA) is looking to ramp up local dairy production with a P237.9-million laboratory that would allow farmers to breed more female carabaos for milk production. The DA inaugurated the world’s first laboratory dedicated exclusively to sex-sorting buffalo semen on Friday in Muñoz, Nueva Ecija. It uses flow cytometry to separate sperm cells carrying female and male chromosomes with about 90 percent accuracy, allowing breeders to select calves primarily for dairy production or for meat and farm work.
